items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Charlie -- remember of course Charlie had his first experience in a high school band in St. Louis under Professor Bowles.

ctx.x: Ringling Brothers Circus, in the side show. And P.G. Lowry was a concert musician. He really could blow the trumpet, and Charlie -- remember of course Charlie had his first experience in a high school band in St. Louis under Professor Bowles. That's where he learned how to read, how to blow. And my older brother played trumpet.
